items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 100+ Companies Unite to Address Rogue AI Risks
items.summary: Over 100 leading AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, have issued a joint call for action to establish safeguards against the potential risks of rogue AI systems.

items.title: Google's AMIE Medical AI System Demonstrates Real-Time Clinical Video Consultation Capabilities
items.summary: Google Research's AMIE medical AI system has showcased its ability to conduct real-time clinical video consultations in a groundbreaking study, advancing AI's role in healthcare diagnostics.

items.title: Barret Zoph, Former Thinking Machines Co-founder, Joins Google After OpenAI Stint
items.summary: Barret Zoph, a co-founder of Thinking Machines who briefly joined OpenAI, has now moved to Google, marking a significant talent shift in the competitive AI landscape.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Confirmed for AI Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Key representatives from leading AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI are set to speak on the AI stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, signaling major announcements or discussions.

items.title: PAWBench: Evaluating Probabilistic Alignment in World Modeling for AI Agents
items.summary: A new benchmark, PAWBench, has been introduced to assess how close AI models are to achieving probabilistically aligned world modeling, crucial for robust agent behavior.

items.title: VGI-Bench: A New Benchmark for Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
items.summary: Researchers introduce VGI-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate and understand the visual intelligence capabilities of advanced video generation models.

items.title: OpenAI Expands Global Footprint with New Presence in Brazil
items.summary: OpenAI announces its expansion into Brazil, aiming to foster AI innovation and collaboration within the Latin American region.

items.title: Enterprise AI's True Risk Lies in Inter-Agent Complexity, Not Autonomy
items.summary: A new analysis suggests that the primary risk in enterprise AI deployments stems from the intricate complexity and interactions between autonomous agents, rather than the agents' individual autonomy.

items.title: JIT-Agent: Enhancing Harness Intelligence through Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
items.summary: JIT-Agent proposes a novel method for scaling AI harness intelligence by enabling just-in-time evolution of the harness itself, improving adaptability and performance.

items.title: What Defines Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents
items.summary: This paper explores the characteristics of effective data for training LLM agents, proposing an ACE (Action, Context, Evaluation) lens for better data generation strategies.

items.title: Google Search Introduces New AI-Powered Features for Travel Planning and Booking
items.summary: Google Search has rolled out three new AI-enhanced features designed to streamline and improve the user experience for planning and booking travel.

items.title: Velocidade de entrega e custo de manutenção pós IA (Delivery Speed and Maintenance Cost Post-AI)
items.summary: This article discusses the impact of AI on software development, specifically focusing on how it affects delivery speed and post-deployment maintenance costs.

items.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization for Improved AI Agent Performance
items.summary: Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO) is introduced as a method to refine AI agent policies dynamically during testing, leading to enhanced performance in real-world scenarios.

items.title: OpenAI Supports Thailand's Next Generation of AI Startups
items.summary: OpenAI announces initiatives to support and nurture the emerging AI startup ecosystem in Thailand, fostering local innovation and talent.

items.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Researchers present 'PILOT in the Loop,' a system enabling long-horizon AI agents to achieve live self-improvement through continuous feedback and adaptation.
